hook.line: The best total in baccarat. Tens and face cards count as zero, and only the last digit of the total matters.
hook.say: Let’s peek into the story of baccarat!

ch.say: It began in Europe’s high society.
p: Legend places its origin in 15th-century Italy, but firm records begin with 19th-century French “baccara” and “chemin de fer”.
In the 20th century the house-banked “punto banco” spread through Latin America, then starred in Las Vegas — and in Macau.

ch.say: It crossed oceans to become Asia’s star.

ch.cap: The King counts 0, the 9 counts 9: a two-card 9 is an unbeatable “natural”
p: Just bet on whether the Player or the Banker will get closer to 9.
Whether a third card is drawn follows fixed rules — a game of luck and flow.
